source_file.provenance: Nott et al. 2019 Science supplementary Table S5, supplied directly by the user after PMC served a 1,817-byte proof-of-work interstitial to automated requests. The gate was not circumvented.

_meta.note: Astrocytes have enhancer/promoter sheets but NO interactome sheet, so only three cell types carry contact maps.

governance.exposure: coordinates, widths, FDR, ClusterType and span distributions only. NO gene annotation joined, no target/program gene touched, no regulatory molecular outcome opened.

fdr_threshold.evidence: the microglial sheet's MAXIMUM fdr is 0.00999901918857552 and all 104,802 rows are < 0.01, so the distributed table is already thresholded at FDR < 0.01 by the depositors
fdr_threshold.contract_clause: C2 - USE THE SOURCE'S OWN PUBLISHED THRESHOLD; do not re-threshold to a value chosen by us

distance_window_bp.evidence: observed cis span range across all 104,802 microglial rows
distance_window_bp.contract_clause: C5 - no additional distance filter; the window is inherited and recorded

anchor_width_bp.evidence: both anchors are exactly 5,000 bp in 104,802 of 104,802 rows

GENOME_BUILD_VERIFIED_AT_COORDINATE_LEVE.conclusion: 249,205,000 EXCEEDS the hg38 chr1 length and fits within hg19, so the table CANNOT be hg38. The build is confirmed by coordinates rather than by trusting the paper text.
GENOME_BUILD_VERIFIED_AT_COORDINATE_LEVE.consequence: C3 harmonization hg19 -> hg38 is required, with a round-trip qualification and counted attrition

STRUCTURE.all_cis: 0 trans rows in all three interactomes
STRUCTURE.chromosomes: 22 autosomes; NO chrX or chrY in any interactome
STRUCTURE.promoter_anchored: PLAC-seq with H3K4me3 enrichment, so one anchor is a promoter by assay design - the shape C4's promoter-fixed distal shuffle assumes

CELL_TYPE_COMPARATORS_FOR_P3.why_it_matters: C7 requires cell-type negatives to be non-trivial: the gene must be expressed in microglia, the distal element accessible in microglia, and only the RELATIONSHIP absent from the microglial map. Having the neuronal and oligodendrocyte interactomes from the SAME study, assay and pipeline is what makes that test constructible without importing a new batch effect.

A_GAP_BETWEEN_THE_CONTRACT_AND_THE_AVAIL.issue: C4/P1 requires CROSS-SOURCE contact concordance to beat a promoter-fixed distal shuffle before E2 is built. With DS010 embargoed to 2027-02-01 and the Yang pcHi-C artifact unlocated, there is NO second admissible contact source, so P1 AS WRITTEN CANNOT BE EXECUTED.
A_GAP_BETWEEN_THE_CONTRACT_AND_THE_AVAIL.what_is_NOT_a_substitute: cross-CELL-TYPE concordance within Nott. Microglia-vs-neuronal agreement tests cell-type sharing, not independent external support, and treating it as P1 would silently redefine the precondition.
A_GAP_BETWEEN_THE_CONTRACT_AND_THE_AVAIL.status: RAISED, NOT WORKED AROUND. The C1 fallback authorises a Nott-centered object, but it does not say what replaces P1 for a single-source object. That is a contract gap and needs an explicit decision before E2 is constructed.
